# Preamble

## Load libraries

```{r libraries}
#| message: false

## Tidyverse, etc.:
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(flextable)
## Bioconductor:
library(txdbmaker)
library(GenomeInfoDb)
library(rtracklayer)
library(edgeR)
## Set RMarkdown params when run interactively:
if (! exists("params", mode = "list")) {
  params <- list(dir_data = "~/data")
}
```

## Define functions

```{r func-read-counts}
#| cache: true

read_counts <- function(file_gene_counts) {
  read_tsv(
    file_gene_counts,
    ## Ignore the command execution metadata.
    skip = 1L,
    col_types = cols(
      Geneid = "c",
      Chr = "c",
      ## The Start, End, and Strand columns can contain contatenations like
      ## value1;value2, so even if Start and End contain integer data, read in
      ## as characters for this concatenation edge case.
      Start = "c",
      End = "c",
      Strand = "c",
      .default = "i"
    )) |>
  rename_with(
    ~ basename(.x) |>
      str_remove(fixed(".bam")),
    where(is.integer) & ends_with(".bam"))
}
```

# DGE-GO-KEGG Analysis

## Entrez annotations

```{r load-counts-entrez}
#| cache: true
#| dependson: -1

## Subread featureCounts.
file_gene_counts_entrez <-
  file.path(params$dir_data, "counts", "refseqhg38p14.featureCounts")

## Import the gene expression counts.
df_counts_entrez <- read_counts(file_gene_counts_entrez)
df_counts_entrez
```

```{r dge-entrez}
#| cache: true
#| dependson: -1
#| results: asis

y <-
  DGEList(
    counts =
      df_counts_entrez |>
      dplyr::select("Geneid", last_col(7):last_col()) |>
      tibble::column_to_rownames("Geneid"),
    group = gl(4, 2, labels = c("ctrl", "e2", "iav", "e2iav"))
  )
keep <- filterByExpr(y)
y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
y <- normLibSizes(y)

fit <- glmQLFit(y)

flextable(as.data.frame(fit$design))

cols <- colnames(fit$design)
empty_list <- function() {
  vector("list", ncol(fit$design)) |>
    setNames(cols)
}
qlf <- empty_list()
go <- empty_list()
kegg <- empty_list()
print_table <- function(df) {
  df |>
    (function(df) tibble::rownames_to_column(df, "ID"))() |>
    mutate(
      across(
        starts_with(fixed("P.")),
        ~ formatC(.x, format = "e", digits = 3))) |>
    flextable() |>
    knitr::knit_print() |>
    cat()
}
for (coef in seq_along(cols)) {
  qlf[[coef]] <- glmQLFTest(fit, coef = coef)

  go[[coef]] <- goana(qlf[[coef]])
  message("GO up ", cols[coef], ":")
  print_table(topGO(go[[coef]], sort = "up"))
  message("GO down ", cols[coef], ":")
  print_table(topGO(go[[coef]], sort = "down"))

  kegg[[coef]] <- kegga(qlf[[coef]])
  message("KEGG up ", cols[coef], ":")
  print_table(topKEGG(kegg[[coef]], sort = "up"))
  message("KEGG up ", cols[coef], ":")
  print_table(topKEGG(kegg[[coef]], sort = "down"))
}
```

## Ensembl annotations

```{r load-counts-ensembl}
#| cache: true
#| dependson: func-read-counts

## Subread featureCounts.
file_gene_counts_ensembl <-
  file.path(params$dir_data, "counts", "ens115.featureCounts")

df_counts_ensembl <- read_counts(file_gene_counts_ensembl)
df_counts_ensembl
```

```{r dge-ensembl}
#| cache: true
#| dependson: -1

y <-
  DGEList(
    counts =
      df_counts_ensembl |>
      dplyr::select("Geneid", last_col(7):last_col()) |>
      tibble::column_to_rownames("Geneid"),
    group = gl(4, 2, labels = c("ctrl", "e2", "iav", "e2iav"))
  )
keep <- filterByExpr(y)
y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
y <- normLibSizes(y)

fit <- glmQLFit(y)

fit$design

## According to goana, no DE genes for e2 treated only (coef = 2L)!
qlf <- glmQLFTest(fit, coef = 3L)

try({
  go <- goana(qlf)
})

## Per https://support.bioconductor.org/p/103096/ "KEGG supports either FlyBase
## CG Ids or Entrez Gene Ids (see below), so you have to supply one or the
## other."
g <- getGeneKEGGLinks("hsa")
head(g)  # Look like Entrez IDs to me.
```

```{r load-anno-ensembl-raw-from-file}
#| cache: true

## Ensembl 115.
file_gene_anno <-
  file.path(params$dir_data, "anno", "Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.115.gtf.gz")

## Import gene model.
system.time({
  txdb_file <- makeTxDbFromGFF(
    file_gene_anno,
    metadata = data.frame(
      name = "Resource URL",
      value =
        fs::path(
          "https://ftp.ensembl.org",
          "pub",
          "release-115",
          "gtf",
          "homo_sapiens",
          "Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.115.gtf.gz")),
    organism = "Homo sapiens",
    taxonomyId = 9606L
  ) |>
    keepStandardChromosomes()
})
```

```{r modify-anno-ensembl-raw-from-file}
#| cache: true
#| dependson: -1

seqinfo <-
  Seqinfo(genome = "hg38") |>
  keepStandardChromosomes()

## We can never fix the seqinfo information because it keeps trying to force old
## invalid NA values:
try({
  seqinfo(txdb_file) <-
    Seqinfo(
      seqnames = seqnames(seqinfo(txdb_file)),
      seqlengths = setNames(seqlengths(seqinfo), seqnames(seqinfo(txdb_file))),
      isCircular = isCircular(seqinfo(txdb_file)))
})
try({
  seqlengths(txdb_file) <-
    setNames(seqlengths(seqinfo), seqnames(seqinfo(txdb_file)))
})
isCircular(seqinfo) <- (function() {
  x <- vector(length = 25)
  x[] <- NA
  x[length(x)] <- TRUE
  x
})()
try({
  seqinfo(txdb_file, new2old = seq_along(seqinfo)) <- seqinfo
})
```

```{r load-anno-ensembl-from-web-sql}
#| cache: true

## Per above, there's no easy way to set the seqinfo for the gtf file so use
## MariaDB and download from the online resource.
system.time({
  txdb_all <- makeTxDbFromEnsembl(release = 115)
})
txdb <-
  txdb_all |>
  keepStandardChromosomes()
```
